AI-Powered Video Summarization for Smart Learning

Ask a lecture — or an entire course playlist — and get answers grounded in what was actually said
PROBLEM STATEMENT & OBJECTIVE
  • A one-hour lecture cannot be searched — re-watching is the only option
  • A course is many videos; a topic is taught across several of them
  • Generic AI summaries invent facts the lecture never stated
OBJECTIVES
  • Turn a video, or a whole playlist, into a searchable study guide
  • Every claim traceable to a real moment in a real video
  • Answer questions using only what was actually said
SOLUTION
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation — only retrieved transcript reaches the model
  • Course mode — one shared index across a playlist, answers cite video + timestamp
  • Timestamp validation — any moment not in the retrieved text is discarded
  • Grounded refusal — returns “not covered in this video” instead of guessing

Stages 1–6 run in fixed order; layers 7–9 apply across all of them. Stage 9 is reviewed offline — scores never change a setting on their own.
GENAI MODEL & TECHNIQUES
Generation by open-mistral-nemo (Mistral) · embeddings by all-MiniLM-L6-v2 · vector store ChromaDB
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation
  • Role prompting
  • Grounding constraint
  • Structured output (JSON schema)
  • Few-shot exemplar
